name: Feedback Academy
description: Practice giving high-quality formative feedback on AI scenarios, then apply skills to real classmate work

intro.message:
Welcome to Feedback Academy! You'll practice giving effective formative feedback.

First: Practice on a made-up scenario
Then: Give feedback to real classmates

Remember: Great feedback is specific, actionable, timely, and focused on improvement!

practice-intro.message:
PRACTICE ROUND

You'll see a made-up scenario. Your job: Give high-quality formative feedback.

Focus on being:
✓ Specific (point to exact details)
✓ Actionable (suggest concrete next steps)
✓ Growth-oriented (help them improve)
✓ Balanced (strengths + areas to develop)

generate-scenarios.instruction: Generate 1 realistic student work scenario that needs feedback. It should be a plausible example of student work with both strengths and clear areas for improvement. Format as JSON object: {"id": 1, "work": "the student's work/response", "context": "what the assignment was"}. Make the work authentic to middle/high school level - not too polished, showing genuine student effort but with room to grow. The work sample should be 2-4 sentences long. Make it feel real - include minor errors, incomplete thoughts, or unclear explanations that feedback could address.

coach-feedback.instruction: You are a friendly feedback coach. Read all the feedback the class just wrote about the practice scenario. In 4-6 warm sentences addressed to the whole class: name two things the class did well (quote a short snippet or two, never with names), then give the ONE most common way this class could make its feedback more specific and actionable. Coach a team, don't grade individuals, no scores, no rankings.

real-intro.message:
REAL ROUND

Now apply what you learned!

Everyone will submit work, then you'll give feedback to a real classmate.

Remember:
✓ Be specific
✓ Be actionable
✓ Focus on growth
✓ Balance strengths + areas to develop

collect-work.prompt:
Submit your work for peer feedback, your teacher will say what to submit (a paragraph, a solution, a project idea...).

It will be shared anonymously with one classmate, who will write you feedback.

real-feedback-round.prompt:
A classmate submitted:

"{{collect-work.assigned}}"

Give them formative feedback that would actually help. Be specific, actionable, and constructive, strengths AND one concrete next step.

coach-real-feedback.instruction: You are a friendly feedback coach watching a class practice peer feedback. Read the feedback they wrote for each other. In 3-5 warm sentences addressed to the whole class: say whether the four pillars (specific, actionable, growth-focused, balanced) showed up more than in a typical first try, and quote two great moves you saw (short snippets, never with names). No scores, no rankings, coach the team.

reflection.message:
Great work, Feedback Academy graduates!

Key takeaways:
• Specific > vague
• Actionable > judgmental
• Growth-focused > fixed
• Balanced > one-sided

Keep practicing these skills in all your peer feedback!

end.message: You've completed Feedback Academy! Use these skills to help your classmates grow.
